description: This file implements an OpenAI-compatible embedder class with batching, rate limiting, and validation features, supporting custom API endpoints and handling responses with base64-encoded embeddings.

classes.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbedder
classes.description: A class providing OpenAI-compatible embedding functionality with support for batching, rate limiting, and validation, capable of using custom API endpoints.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Generates embeddings for a list of texts with batching and retries.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by testing endpoint connectivity and API key.

methods.name: waitForGlobalRateLimit
methods.description: Pauses execution if a global rate limit is active.

methods.name: updateGlobalRateLimitState
methods.description: Updates the global rate limit state upon receiving a 429 error.

methods.name: getGlobalRateLimitDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current delay before retrying after a rate limit.

methods.name: isFullEndpointUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL is a full endpoint URL or a base URL.

methods.name: makeDirectEmbeddingRequest
methods.description: Performs a direct HTTP request to the embeddings endpoint for full URLs.

methods.name: _embedBatchWithRetries
methods.description: Handles batch embedding requests with retries and exponential backoff.
